The '''C-14A stun grenade''' was a small grenade with the aim of incapacitating rather than killing targets. It was manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] It had a metallic sphere covered in [[Beam splitter/Legends|beam splitters]] and a clublike handle. The grenade held energy in [[optic capacitor]]s that would discharge when it was used. The blast would hit the beam splitters and cover the area in stunning energy.<ref name="gundark" />

It was designed to be recovered, recharged and reused. This often led to the grenades later being used against the troops who originally used them.
